cumleler: In noise, does turning up both speech and noise help?
People who struggle in noise need a higher signal-to-noise ratio.
The difference from normal hearing is SNR loss; here, eight decibels.
Raising speech and noise together does not change this ratio.
So it does not close the SNR loss.
Solutions like directional or remote microphones are needed instead.
